== Summary ==
'''CardMaker recreation''' of [[Dengar (V) (Virtual Block 2) (Card list text)|Dengar (V) (Virtual Block 2) (Errata)]] (<code>1220_10</code>, Virtual Block 2 slip 10), showing the '''PC-E1''' game text. No published image shows this text: the Virtual Block 2 release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB2-10-Dengar.png]]) and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB2-D-dengar-pre.gif]]) both show the original text of [[Dengar (V) (Virtual Block 2)]].

* '''Text source:''' Players Committee website card list (VBlock2Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064711/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock2Type.html 21 July 2012] (Internet Archive). The card list drops icons; icons are drawn as on the printed slip.
* '''PC-E1 text:''' “Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. Deploys free aboard Punishing One, and while piloting it, draws one battle destiny if unable to otherwise. At same site, Han's game text is canceled. Immune to Fallen Portal.”
* '''Made:''' 8 November 2026 with the SWCCG CardMaker (https://swccg.com/cardmaker/, repo billbisco/swccg-cardmaker, STANDARD rev 71): the card's own Virtual Legacy card <code>1002_L6246</code> (printed frame, Decipher art <code>4_100</code>, title, lore, icons, slip number 10, Virtual Block 2 set mark) with the PC-E1 game text. Holotable size, 745 × 1039.
* '''Not an official image.''' Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
